reason: I already trade for free on Robinhood and Public, and they're rolling out their own AI stuff, so I don't see why I'd pay a monthly fee for a cute pet to do what my broker and ChatGPT already do. The demo money thing is fun, but I'm not paying for a plan that doesn't even have a broker or a price yet.
objection: It's an extra subscription on top of free tools I already use, and handing my real money to an unnamed broker partner through a new app makes me nervous. What does this do that my broker's free AI won't?
would_change_my_mind: If after a couple of months on demo money it clearly beat what I'd do myself, and the real-money side was with a broker I already know, I'd consider a cheap plan.
